title: Hypermerge
description: Docs edited with Automerge 0.9.2 and kept as hypermerge kept them: one append-only feed per actor, each block one change, signed by the actor's key. The page only ever adds rows.

block.description: One block of one actor's feed: block index i holds the actor's change seq i + 1. Its eid is the SHA-256 of its bytes, the canonical JSON of the change.

doc.description: The doc's id: its root actor's key.

actor.description: The feed's key: the writing actor's Ed25519 public key in base58, which is also its Automerge actor id.

change.description: The Automerge change: actor, seq, deps, message and ops.

sig.description: The actor's Ed25519 signature, in hex, of its feed's Merkle tree hash once this block was appended.

actor.description: One member of a doc's actor set, kept apart from every feed as hypermerge kept it.

key.description: The actor's public key in base58: its id and its feed's key.
